content:
Customer says: 'I paid for Premium yesterday but the app still shows Free. Turn on Premium now.'

Case facts:
- Billing event B-918 says card authorization succeeded.
- Subscription table still shows plan=Free.
- Invoice I-551 is marked pending_settlement.
- Entitlement sync last ran before B-918.
- The pending state started 3 hours ago.

Policy excerpts:
[P1] Premium access starts when invoice status is paid.
[P2] If payment is authorized but pending settlement, ask the customer to wait or escalate to billing if the pending state exceeds 24 hours.
[P3] Agents must not manually grant Premium unless invoice status is paid or billing approves an override.

Resolve the case.
